data.case_title: Witness summons (Ladung) – Amtsgericht Musterquedlin, Case 2 C 318/26
data.explanation: The local court (Amtsgericht) summons you to testify as a witness in a civil case between a roofing company and a customer about payment for work. You must appear at the hearing on the date and time shown, bringing this summons letter and an official photo ID. If you cannot attend, you need a sufficient excuse (e.g. illness) accepted by the court beforehand; otherwise you could be charged the costs caused by your absence and a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under §380 of the Code of Civil Procedure (ZPO). You can claim compensation for travel costs and lost earnings under the Justizvergütungsgesetz (JVEG). There is no legal remedy to file against a witness summons itself.

items.title: Court hearing – testify as a witness

items.consequence: If you fail to appear without sufficient excuse, you may be charged the costs caused and a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under §380 ZPO.
